evidence.text: Clinic A reports median morning fasting glucose 5.4 mmol/L in adults aged 40-49.
Clinic B reports median evening post-prandial glucose 7.8 mmol/L in adults aged 70-79.
Age band, sampling time, and fasting vs post-prandial states differ; the two medians are not the same measured quantity.

prompt: Adjudicate: 'Clinic A contradicts Clinic B about the same glucose quantity.'
title: Context mismatch before contradiction
